gloss: plumbing work; water supply construction; waterworks repair

definitions.gloss: plumbing work; water supply construction; waterworks repair
definitions.explanation: Construction, repair, or maintenance work on water supply and drainage systems, including pipes, faucets, and sewage connections. Encompasses both residential plumbing and public water infrastructure projects.

examples.japanese: {水道工事|すいどうこうじ}のため{断水|だんすい}します。
examples.english: Water will be shut off due to plumbing work.

examples.japanese: {台所|だいどころ}の{水漏|みずも}れを{直|なお}すために{水道工事|すいどうこうじ}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}を{呼|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I called a plumber to fix the kitchen leak.

examples.japanese: {道路|どうろ}で{水道工事|すいどうこうじ}が{行|おこな}われているため、{片側|かたがわ}{通行|つうこう}になっている。
examples.english: Traffic is restricted to one lane because waterworks construction is being carried out on the road.

notes:
Combines {水道|すいどう} (water supply, plumbing) and {工事|こうじ} (construction work). A very practical term encountered in daily life — on road signs, apartment notices, and municipal announcements. The phrase {水道工事|すいどうこうじ}のため{断水|だんすい} ("water shut off for plumbing work") is especially common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水道工事|すいどうこうじ}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: plumbing contractor
- {水道工事|すいどうこうじ}{中|ちゅう}: plumbing work in progress
- {水道工事|すいどうこうじ}の{見積|みつ}もり: plumbing work estimate
- {水道工事|すいどうこうじ}のため{断水|だんすい}: water shutoff for plumbing work

RELATED WORDS:
- {水道管|すいどうかん}: water pipe — the pipes being worked on
- {配管|はいかん}{工事|こうじ}: piping work — a broader term covering all pipe installation
- {下水道|げすいどう}{工事|こうじ}: sewer construction — specifically for drainage systems
